name: Volume Rendering Equation
aliases: Volume Rendering Equation — Radiative Transfer Equation Integration
definition: Algorithms to trace objects represented by densities within a volume grid (e.g., clouds, fog, flames, dust, particle systems) by developing light scattering equations and presenting a new approximate solution to the full three-dimensional radiative scattering problem.
summary: The Volume Rendering Equation computes outgoing radiance by integrating light emission and scattering along a ray through a participating medium, producing physically plausible gas clouds rather than discrete particle artifacts.
